cases.name: a request resumes a Frozen container behind its marker, closes swap, waits for FrankenPHP, then removes the marker
any other state removes only the request and changes nothing
a request whose name is not app-instance-<digits>.wake, a link, or one older than a second is removed and ignored
a silent or 5xx FrankenPHP, or a failed resume, keeps the marker and writes no resumed file
FrankenPHP that answers after a few tries is waited for
the script's folders and port are the Gateway's
the app-dev role installs the script as root and a watch on the request folder, with no capabilities
the Node script and the wake's workflow run the same library check, after the marker went
the library check rebuilds the cache only when a shared runtime library is missing from it
